items.title: MAI-Code-1-Flash
items.author: EvanZhouDev
items.summary: MAI-Code-1-Flash is a new coding model from Microsoft, now available in GitHub Copilot for Visual Studio Code. It is a 5B-parameter model optimized for efficiency. It is part of Microsoft's effort to reduce reliance on third-party providers.

items.title: Agentic Mfw
items.author: elmerland
items.summary: Agentic workflows involve autonomous AI agents making decisions and solving problems with minimal human intervention. They optimize planning and tool use through adaptive reasoning. Agentic systems like AgentFlow coordinate multiple modules for effective problem-solving.

items.title: AI outperforms law professors in Stanford Law study
items.author: berlianta
items.summary: A Stanford Law study led by Professor Julian Nyarko found that law professors prefer AI-generated answers over those written by their peers. The study suggests AI could transform legal education. The research highlights AI's accuracy and efficiency in legal responses.

items.title: Gmail thinks I'm stupid, so I left
items.author: speckx
items.summary: A user left Gmail due to feeling it was condescending, finding its features intrusive. The story was shared on Hacker News and moddedbear.com. The sentiment was echoed on X.

items.title: Open Repair Data Standard – Open Repair Alliance
items.author: cassepipe
items.summary: The Open Repair Data Standard (ORDS) facilitates the collection and sharing of repair data for small electronics, aiming to unify data from various groups. The latest datasets were updated in October 2025. The Open Repair Alliance promotes this standard to enhance repair data accessibility.

items.title: How we index images for RAG
items.author: mooreds
items.summary: To index images for RAG, convert images into embeddings using vision models, then store these embeddings in a vector database alongside text embeddings for unified retrieval. Group related images using metadata for efficient retrieval.

items.title: Trump signs downsized AI order after weeks of reversals
items.author: _alternator_
items.summary: Trump signed a downsized AI executive order after reversing previous regulations. The order blocks states from enforcing their own AI regulations. The order was met with mixed reactions.

items.title: Show HN: Paseo – Beautiful open-source coding agent interface
items.author: timhigins
items.summary: Paseo is an open-source coding agent interface supporting desktop, mobile, and CLI. It runs multiple coding providers through a unified UI and emphasizes privacy with no telemetry or tracking. It is available on multiple platforms.

items.title: QBE – Compiler Backend – 1.3
items.author: birdculture
items.summary: QBE 1.3 is a major compiler backend release with 7k new lines of code, new IL matching algorithm, and position-independent code support. It includes significant optimizations and bug fixes. Released in 2026.

items.title: Can A.I. Produce Writing That We Want to Read?
items.author: fortran77
items.summary: AI can produce writing, but its quality varies; humans often prefer their own creative works. AI assists but doesn't fully replace human creativity.

items.title: More than 6 out of 10 people turn to AI for psychological support
items.author: mgh2
items.summary: Over 60% of people use AI for psychological support, with 21.75% using AI chatbots daily and 22.25% monthly for mental health. AI chatbots are increasingly popular, especially among adolescents and young adults.

items.title: Launch HN: Rudus (YC P26) – AI for concrete contractors
items.author: rishipankhaniya
items.text:
Hi HN, we’re Rishi and Sahil. We’ve developed Rudus (https://www.rudus.ai/), an AI-powered takeoff and estimation platform built for concrete subcontractors.

Takeoff is the process of measuring and quantifying materials from concrete plan sheets. Rudus identifies every concrete structure (footings, walls, columns, slabs), pulls in related details, and eliminates hours of manual quantity calculation. Here’s a demo:
items.summary: Rudus is an AI platform for concrete subcontractors to improve takeoff and estimation processes. It focuses on the specific needs of concrete contractors, unlike general AI tools. Launched by YC P26.

items.title: Adafruit receives demand letter from Fenwick legal counsel on behalf of Flux.ai
items.author: semanser
items.summary: Adafruit received a demand letter from Fenwick legal counsel regarding Flux.ai's intellectual property rights. The letter cites infringement and mentions the Computer Fraud and Abuse Act. The case involves AI training on copyrighted material without permission.

items.title: Rsync and Outrage
items.author: st3fan
items.summary: Rsync is a file synchronization tool, and it can be used with Amazon S3. In case of network disruptions, uploads can be resumed. Rsync's security is a concern due to its exposure on the public internet.

items.title: Show HN: RePlaya – self-hosted browser session replay with live tailing
items.author: shikhar
items.text:
Hi HN, I'm one of the founders of s2.dev. RePlaya (https://github.com/s2-streamstore/replaya) is a self-hosted browser session replay tool using rrweb (https://github.com/rrweb-io/rrweb).

It occurred to me that a durable stream per session would be a much neater architectural fo
items.summary: RePlaya is a self-hosted tool for browser session replay with live tailing. It records user sessions as S2 streams and allows real-time playback. It's open-source and available on GitHub.

items.title: MAI-Thinking-1
items.author: LER0ever
items.summary: MAI-Thinking-1 is Microsoft's advanced reasoning model, trained on clean, licensed data, and preferred in human evaluations over Sonnet 4.6. It aims to build towards Humanist Superintelligence.

items.title: BQN: What Is a Primitive?
items.author: tosh
items.summary: A primitive in BQN is a basic function or modifier built into the language, represented by unique glyphs. They are fundamental operations that form the core of the language. BQN uses symbols for these to streamline coding.
